description: This file defines the implementation of cash-based accounting processing for loans within the Apache Fineract project. It handles creation of various journal entries corresponding to different loan transactions such as disbursements, repayments, refunds, charge-offs, charge adjustments, transfers, and chargebacks, interfacing with helper services for account management and journal entry creation.

classes.name: CashBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan
classes.description: Implements cash-based accounting processing logic specific to loan transactions, including journal entry creation for various transaction types such as disbursements, repayments, charge-offs, refunds, charge adjustments, and transfers.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoan
methods.description: Main method that processes a LoanDTO object to create appropriate journal entries based on each transaction's type.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForChargeOff
methods.description: Handles journal entries for charge-off transactions, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, and overpayments.

methods.name: populateCreditDebitMaps
methods.description: Associates transaction amounts with corresponding credit and debit GL accounts based on loan product and payment type.

methods.name: returnExistingDebitAccountInMapMatchingGLAccount
methods.description: Finds existing debit account entries that match a given GL account to consolidate amounts.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Creates journal entries for charge adjustment transactions, differentiating between regular and charge-off cases.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForChargeOffLoanChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Handles journal entries for charge-off related to loan charge adjustments, including multiple charge types.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoanChargeAdjustment
methods.description: Creates journal entries for adjustments to loan charges.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForRefund
methods.description: Handles journal entries when processing refunds for loans.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForRefundForActiveLoan
methods.description: Creates journal entries for refunds on active loans, accounting for principal, interest, fees, penalties, and overpayment.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForRepayments
methods.description: Main method to process repayment-related journal entries, including charge-offs and regular repayments.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForChargeOffLoanRepayments
methods.description: Handles charge-off specific journal entries during loan repayment processing.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoanRepayments
methods.description: Creates journal entries for loan repayments, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, and overpayments, with optional goodwill accounting.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForRecoveryRepayments
methods.description: Creates journal entries for recovery payments, linking funds source and recovery income accounts.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForTransfers
methods.description: Handles journal entries for initiating and approving transfer transactions.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Creates journal entries for refunds of credit balances (overpayments).

methods.name: populateDebitAccountEntry
methods.description: Adds debit entries to a map, consolidating amounts for the same GL account.
